name: PowerModeTimelineChart
description: Timeline chart for power-mode state changes over time. Wraps {@link TimelineChart} with mining-specific data shaping

props.name: data
props.description: Initial power-mode entries (each with start/end ts + mode)

props.name: dataUpdates
props.description: Streaming updates appended to the initial data

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Show a loading skeleton instead of the chart

props.name: timezone
props.description: IANA timezone string for x-axis tick formatting

fields.name: ts
fields.description: Sample time (epoch ms); consecutive samples with the same mode merge into one bar

fields.name: power_mode_group_aggr
fields.description: Power mode keyed by miner; takes precedence over the miner's status for the bar's mode

fields.name: status_group_aggr
fields.description: Status keyed by miner; its keys decide which miners get a row, and an entry without it adds nothing
